english.note: Use this when the action or mistake was not intentional and the person did not mean any harm.
Use this for a mistake or action that was unintentional and not malicious.

examples.english: It was an innocent mistake—I didn't tear your book on purpose.
examples.traditional: 我唔係有心整爛你本書㗎，真係無心之失。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 zing2 laan6 nei5 bun2 syu1 gaa3 zan1 hai6 mou4 sam1 zi1 sat1

examples.english: Tearing your book was an honest mistake; I really didn't mean to.
examples.traditional: 我真係無心整爛你本書㗎。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou4 sam1 zing2 laan6 nei5 bun2 syu1 gaa3
